summary.consultation_overview: A 23-year-old patient consulted the doctor complaining of a cough lasting for 6 months. The patient noted that the cough started after eating sweet items and due to weather changes, gradually worsening over time despite using over-the-counter cough tablets and syrups.
summary.history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 23-year-old reporting a cough that has persisted for 6 months. It began following the consumption of sweet items and changes in weather, and has gradually prolonged and worsened over time.
